overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing and voting on a temporary administrative aide position in executive session; the later open-session reconsideration was not wholly sufficient, so the AG ordered release of the improper portion of the minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed a topic in executive session outside the stated purpose at its April 22, 2013 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The discussion was not appropriate under any executive session purpose, and therefore should have occurred in a properly posted open session.

remedy: Release the portion of the April 22, 2013 executive session minutes that was not appropriate for discussion in executive session, unless the attorney/client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
remedy_passage: Accordingly, we order the Board to release the portion of the April 22, 2013 executive session minutes that was not appropriate for discussion in executive session, unless the attorney/client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
